title: Worker: retry transient Prospectus 503 in the scope recheck; explicit retry for a failed publication command
description: 2026-10-24 18:23Z: the first priming job of the r2 successor run (0089fae6) failed its scope recheck when Prospectus identities/me returned a transient 503 (ProspectusUnavailable at hosted_publications.py:317 check_scope). Redelivery then refused with CommandReconciliationRequired, the run went busy (run_busy for every command), and an operator reconcile was needed (done 2026-10-25 with Ryan's approval; audit on the job). Two fixes: (1) in the worker's scope recheck, retry ProspectusUnavailable with bounded backoff before giving up, and fail the job as 'interrupted' with a clear reason rather than leaving it running; (2) an explicit retry operation for a failed publication command. Today the same request identity returns the failed job (s3_console_storage.py ~1015), and the priming identity is a hash of the examples, so re-priming an unchanged list is impossible without editing an example. Acceptance: specs for 503-then-success, 503-exhausted ending in a terminal job, and explicit retry creating a new attempt with audit.
